visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a green striped shirt and a white baseball cap with small floral patterns is playing a piano in a brightly lit shopping mall. She has long dark hair and a focused expression. In the background, people walk past luxury store facades like Burberry and Omega. (2) A young boy wearing glasses and a blue t-shirt enters the frame and approaches the woman. He leans in to talk to her while she continues to play. She looks up and smiles at him, engaging in a brief conversation. (3) The boy sits down on the piano bench next to the woman. They begin playing a piano duet together. The camera switches between side shots and front-facing shots, showing their hands moving in coordination on the keys. (4) The woman and the boy finish their performance. They look at each other and smile broadly. The woman holds the boy's hands and high-fives him. They appear to be laughing and talking excitedly about their joint performance.
